fact: The Minister's April 2026 speech asks Parliament for TZS 222,589,451,000 for the ICT ministry in 2026/27, of which TZS 98,480,905,000 is domestic development money, against TZS 291,533,139,000 approved for 2025/26, a fall in the total.
title: Hotuba ya Waziri wa Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari, Makadirio ya Mapato na Matumizi ya Fedha 2026/27
publisher: Wizara ya Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari
